protocol.candidate: VoxLock v2 INT8, threads1, 3s C2-clean enrollment, no automatic enrollment
protocol.quality_gate: Exploratory only: no increase of clean-speech WER errors; strict cpWER/full WER/unknown/negative controls mandatory. cpWER-U cannot improve recovered-null words structurally: identity gate remains unavailable. Natural manual ground truth and independent identity verifier required for integration.
protocol.enrollment: strict-c2: C2 continuous clean>=3100ms,50ms guard; provided-dev: controlled synthetic single-source anchor,250ms guard,3s with natural pauses; unique C2 identity in anchor; neither uses reference text
protocol.overlap: Replace midpoint-in-C2-overlap words only; baseline kept elsewhere; no identity verifier -> null speaker
protocol.word_recall: NOT_SCORED: no independent reference word times
protocol.parity: Actual production OfflineAsr/TokenWords/fusion/C2; host JNI build differs from signed APK; QuietCuts refines each waveform independently; extra word decode excluded from app timing
